maximum_permitted_stay: No universal maximum published; duration is approved by the Island Council; some visitors stay six months or more.
passport_validity_rule: A valid ordinary passport is required; no minimum remaining validity is published in the reviewed visitor guidance.
blank_passport_pages_rule: No minimum blank-page count is published in the reviewed visitor guidance.
return_ticket_rule: Confirmed and fully paid return passage is required; proposed vessel and travel dates must be supplied.
proof_of_funds_rule: Sufficient funds to cover the entire approved stay are required; no fixed amount is published.
accommodation_rule: Accommodation sought/details must be included in the advance request; arrangements are subject to local availability and approval.
travel_insurance_rule: Adequate insurance for medical treatment and emergency medical evacuation to Cape Town is required.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No destination-specific vaccination rule was identified in the reviewed visitor guidance; medical treatment and evacuation insurance is required.
transit_rule: No separate island transit-visa procedure is published. Travel is vessel-based; entry or transit permission for embarkation and onward countries is itinerary-dependent.
application_channel: Email tdcenquiries@tdc-gov.com with visit purpose, dates, nationality, age, preferred vessel and accommodation; obtain prior Island Council approval and a landing stamp.
application_fee: No visa fee; main-island landing/harbour charge: GBP 30 cruise; GBP 15 yacht.
processing_time: No published decision SLA; vessel schedules may require planning more than a year ahead.
required_documents: Valid ordinary passport|Prior written approval from the Administrator / Island Council|Proposed visit purpose, dates, nationality, age, preferred vessel and accommodation details|Confirmed and fully paid return passage|Adequate travel insurance covering medical treatment and emergency evacuation to Cape Town|Evidence of sufficient funds for the entire approved stay
